QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Connect to an NTRIP caster and forward RTCM corrections to connected vehicles.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: host
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Hostname or IP address of the NTRIP caster.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: port
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: TCP port of the NTRIP caster.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: mountpoint
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: NTRIP mountpoint to request from the caster.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: username
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Username for NTRIP basic authentication. Leave blank for public casters.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: password
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Password for NTRIP basic authentication. Leave blank for public casters.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: sendGGA
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Send periodic NMEA GGA messages to the caster using the active vehicle position when available.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ggaInterval
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Interval between GGA position updates sent to the NTRIP caster.
